description: Benchmark question-answer pairs for evaluating the RAG pipeline over security logs (firewall.log and vpn.log). Reduced from 25 to 15 questions to stay within GitHub Models API daily limits. All ground-truth answers verified against log files dated 2025-05-01.

questions.question: What destination IP was blocked when source 10.1.1.5 attempted outbound traffic at 2025-05-01 08:02:11?
questions.ground_truth: 8.8.8.8. The firewall log shows: 2025-05-01 08:02:11 FIREWALL_DENY src=10.1.1.5 dst=8.8.8.8 policy=OUTBOUND_BLOCK.

questions.question: Which user had a successful VPN login at 2025-05-01 08:10:30?
questions.ground_truth: alice.smith logged in successfully from IP 192.168.1.50 at 2025-05-01 08:10:30.

questions.question: What firewall policy was triggered for source IP 172.16.0.4 at 2025-05-01 08:31:55?
questions.ground_truth: PORT_SCAN_DETECTED. The event blocked traffic from 172.16.0.4 to destination 45.33.32.156.

questions.question: From which IP address did john.doe attempt VPN login at 2025-05-01 08:01:05?
questions.ground_truth: 185.22.11.4. The log entry reads: 2025-05-01 08:01:05 VPN_LOGIN_FAILED user=john.doe ip=185.22.11.4.

questions.question: How many total FIREWALL_DENY events are recorded in the firewall log?
questions.ground_truth: 28 FIREWALL_DENY events are recorded in firewall.log.

questions.question: What are the three distinct firewall policy types in the logs?
questions.ground_truth: OUTBOUND_BLOCK (15 events), INBOUND_BLOCK (8 events), and PORT_SCAN_DETECTED (5 events).

questions.question: How many OUTBOUND_BLOCK firewall events does source IP 10.1.1.5 have?
questions.ground_truth: 5 OUTBOUND_BLOCK events originate from source IP 10.1.1.5.

questions.question: How many VPN login failures did user john.doe have?
questions.ground_truth: john.doe had 7 VPN_LOGIN_FAILED events, all from IP 185.22.11.4.

questions.question: How many OUTBOUND_BLOCK firewall events occurred between 08:00 and 09:00 on 2025-05-01?
questions.ground_truth: 5 OUTBOUND_BLOCK events occurred in that hour (at 08:02:11, 08:05:33, 08:11:47, 08:22:19, and 08:45:08).

questions.question: How many VPN events of any type occurred between 10:00 and 11:00 on 2025-05-01?
questions.ground_truth: 5 VPN events occurred in that hour (at 10:05:49, 10:18:22, 10:31:07, 10:44:55, and 10:58:30).

questions.question: Did john.doe experience three VPN login failures within a 10-minute window around 08:01 on 2025-05-01?
questions.ground_truth: Yes. john.doe failed at 08:01:05, 08:03:44, and 08:06:12 — all within a 5-minute window.

questions.question: Which IP addresses appear in both VPN login failures and firewall deny events?
questions.ground_truth: Three IPs appear in both logs: 185.22.11.4 (7 VPN failures, 4 firewall blocks), 203.0.113.7 (7 VPN failures, 1 firewall block), and 172.16.0.4 (4 VPN failures, 3 firewall blocks).

questions.question: How many VPN failures and firewall events are associated with IP 185.22.11.4?
questions.ground_truth: IP 185.22.11.4 is linked to 7 VPN login failures (user john.doe) and 4 firewall INBOUND_BLOCK events as the source IP.

questions.question: Which VPN user is associated with the IP address that triggered PORT_SCAN_DETECTED firewall events?
questions.ground_truth: mallory.x. That user had 4 VPN login failures from IP 172.16.0.4, which is also the source IP in 3 PORT_SCAN_DETECTED firewall events.

questions.question: Is IP 203.0.113.7 involved in both VPN failures and firewall blocks?
questions.ground_truth: Yes. eve.hacker had 7 VPN login failures from 203.0.113.7, and the firewall denied inbound traffic from 203.0.113.7 to 10.1.1.5 at 11:03:58 under policy INBOUND_BLOCK.
